title: Automatic remediation for operator image-digest mismatch causing upgrade stalls in customer VPCs
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Summary: Several customer escalations across Private/VPC tenants in the last 48 hours point to upgrade jobs stalling when the onprem operator deployment pulls a rewritten image digest during rolling upgrades. Root cause appears to be a combination of upstream OCI registry tag rotation (image immutable digests changed for a mirrored image), aggressive imagePullPolicy semantics in our Helm templates, and our operator reconciler treating Image ID mismatch as irrecoverable state. Result: nodeagent pods crashloop or are replaced repeatedly, Helm upgrade hangs waiting for deployment success, and some clusters experience admission webhook rejections leading to degraded control-plane interactions.
comments: 2026-03-10 09:12 - Triage: Customer A reported a blocked upgrade; logs show ImagePullBackOff because the operator spec references digest sha256:OLD which no longer exists in mirror. Customer B has a similar pattern in EU region. Escalated to oncall infra.

2026-03-10 11:40 - Investigation: Confirmed two failure modes: (1) digest rotation at mirror leading to ImagePullBackOff, (2) our operator's preflight check marks CR as 'immutable mismatch' and refuses to continue upgrade path. Observed Helm release stuck in POST_UPGRADE hook waiting for operator readiness. Added a temporary status tag to telemetry to measure scope.

2026-03-10 14:05 - Customer comms: Notified affected customers with mitigation steps (manual image rebase or temporary set imagePullPolicy=IfNotPresent). Promised a hotfix within 72 hours. Linked incident channel: https://redwood.example/incident/INC-20260310-operator-digest

2026-03-11 08:22 - Decision: Short-term mitigation plan agreed: (A) add an automated reconciler that detects image digest Unavailable errors and attempts safe fallback to a compatible tag variant or previous deployed image ID (if available) for the duration of a rollout; (B) add Helm preflight guard that will retry with backoff instead of failing the release when image pull errors are transient; (C) shipping a 1-line operator container image policy change in Helm values to prefer IfNotPresent for rolling upgrades by default behind a feature flag.

2026-03-11 10:00 - Engineering plan: Miguel to own implementation. Steps: 1) feature flag gate; 2) add new reconciler routine 'imageFallback' that looks up nodeagent lastSuccessfulImage annotation and attempts patch; 3) Helm chart patch to make imagePullPolicy configurable; 4) add a safe rollback hook that sets operator replicas=0 for 30s to let stuck hooks clear if remediation fails.

2026-03-11 16:30 - PoC: PoC branch created: github.com/redwood/inference-onprem/pull/PR-489 (poC imageFallback and helm value). PoC demonstrates remediation on a reproducer cluster by rewriting deployment to use last-known-good image id then letting the operator resume. Unit tests added for reconciler logic.

2026-03-12 09:05 - QA: Integration smoke runs on internal test harness (vagrant and cloud sim clusters): simulated registry rotation; PoC remediates 87% of cases. Failure cases found when customers have immutable image admission policies; added a detection and explicit warning in logs and flare diagnostics.

2026-03-12 14:20 - Customer testing: Customer C accepted a canary deployment of the hotfix in a staging cluster; their upgrade completed. They provided logs and a minimal kubeconfig for reproduction. Customer feedback: "fix resolved the hang and reduced manual intervention".

2026-03-12 18:00 - Rollout plan: Ship onprem-operator-1.6.4-hotfix behind feature flag 'operator-image-fallback'. Staged rollout schedule: two non-critical customers tonight, then 25% of dedicated tenants tomorrow, then all remaining private clusters if no regressions. Monitoring: create dashboard tile (upgrade-time, helm-hook-duration, image-pull-error-rate) and alert if hook duration > 15m.

2026-03-13 08:40 - Docs/Runbook: Drafted runbook entries and customer KB article for support engineers: steps to manually patch deployments, how to apply the hotfix Helm chart with --set operator.imagePullPolicy=IfNotPresent, and how to collect flare: /confluence/onprem/upgrade-hotfix-runbook. Linked PR: github.com/redwood/helm-charts/pull/PR-92

2026-03-13 11:15 - Post-release checklist (pre-merge): security review of fallback logic (no secrets exposed) required? Security team says fallback must not pull images from unverified registries. Added static allowlist check and image source validation to reconciler. Marking security_review_required: false for release but we added validation in code path.

2026-03-13 12:40 - Release notes draft: "Fix: prevent helm upgrade stalls when operator/container image digest is missing from mirror by auto-fallback to last-known-good image and configurable imagePullPolicy. Introduces feature flag operator-image-fallback."

2026-03-13 12:55 - Next steps: Finalize tests (integration + e2e), complete PR review, coordinate with SRE to schedule staged rollout, notify sales/CS for proactive customer outreach, and prepare rollback plan if any customer experiences immutable admission policy conflict. Estimate remaining: 2d of work.
